name: Scroll Area
description: A scrollable region with styled, theme-consistent scrollbars.

anatomy.description: The keyboard-focusable scrollable region, capped by maxHeight.
The styled vertical and horizontal tracks shown while scrolling is possible.
The draggable indicator sized to the visible fraction of the content.

dos: Cap the height in relative units so the region adapts to the viewport.
Use it for bounded panels, sidebars, and pickers.
Keep one scroll region per panel.
donts: Don't nest scroll areas inside each other.
Don't use it for page-level scrolling; let the page scroll natively.
Don't hide critical actions below the fold without a visible affordance.

examples.title: Bounded lists
examples.description: Cap the height and the custom scrollbar appears only while scrolling is possible.

examples.title: Panel lists
examples.description: Pair with a fixed maxHeight so the page itself keeps its own scroll.

guidance.useWhen: A panel needs a bounded height with theme-consistent scrollbars.
guidance.avoidWhen: The page itself should scroll; do not nest page-level scrolling.
guidance.behavior: The custom thumb appears over a transparent track only where scrolling is possible; the viewport is keyboard focusable.
guidance.responsive: Set maxHeight in relative units so the region adapts to viewport height.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the scrollable viewport.

notes: The viewport is focusable with tabIndex 0, so keyboard users can scroll content that has no focusable children.
The styled scrollbar and thumb are visual only; scrolling itself stays native.

props.description: Content rendered inside the scrollable viewport.
props.name: children

props.description: Caps the viewport height; content beyond it scrolls.
props.name: maxHeight
